title: Private compute network reset
summary: privAI is not an AI model marketplace; it is a post-quantum FullPrivacy private AI compute network.
content: Privacy is the product. Compute is the supply. PVA is the incentive. Chain is the settlement. Transport is the shield.
do_not_overclaim: do not infer public marketplace baseline

title: Settlement uses receipts and metering
summary: Settlement is based on compute lease policy, receipts, metering, and timeouts, not subjective AI output quality.
content: Pro-rata and operatorless settlement are direction targets, not current implementation claims.
do_not_overclaim: do not infer pro-rata is implemented
do not infer operatorless escrow is implemented
